review: Local host/Windows integration and review required even after kit tests pass.
name: Function Envelope
behavior: Original gated AR: unpatched gate0; >=.5 means high. On rising edge rise from current level to1; hold1 while high; on falling edge fall from current level to0; hold0 while low.
Repeated high does not retrigger. Edges during rise/fall start the corresponding segment continuously from current level. Reset level0/gate low; retain parameter targets.
Latch segment duration N=max(1,llround(seconds*sampleRate)) and Curve at each edge. Output next endpoint fraction u=elapsed/N, clamp exact endpoint at N.
Shape F(u)=expm1(k*u)/expm1(k), k=4*Curve; at Curve0 use F(u)=u. Output=start+(end-start)*F(u). Negative Curve is fast-start/log-like; positive slow-start/exp-like.
No extra smoothing across gate edges; curves and times are latched for a segment, no cycle/trigger/extra Maths channels in v1.
acceptance: Analytic midpoint/endpoints at Curve -1/0/+1; continuous retrigger from nonzero level.
Held-high hold1; released gate reaches0 after exact Fall samples; early release during Rise.
All rates/partitions, reset/unpatched behavior; no claim of exact MATHS analog behavior.
